text:
jackie: Heads up — noticed a console dashboard showing metrics for workspace 672 inside workspace 118 when switching quickly. Not sure if repro or race. Screenshot attached :eyes:
alex: which dashboard? can you repro? steps?
jackie: open /dashboards/usage, switch org via quick-switch twice fast, filter 'All teams' -> shows rows from other org
ben: probable prefetch + route affinity bug. quick-switch sets header but prefetch uses cached route
priya: can you paste network trace? maybe X-Workspace header missing on prefetch call
jackie: here's the trace snippet:
```http
GET /internal/console/widget-data?dashboard_id=usage&preview=true HTTP/1.1
Host: console.internal
Cookie: session=eyJ...; workspace=118
X-Redwood-Org: 672
```
alex: aha header is 672 while cookie workspace=118 — mismatch
sam: that's a known timing window when route-affinity updates but cookie lags. we tried guard but maybe prefetch uses legacy internal API that reads cookie not header
ben: internal-api debate: should console internal endpoints trust header over cookie? current impl trusts cookie for backward compat for iframe apps
priya: we added a feature flag `prefetch-v2` that flips internal api to prefer header. can we rollout to prod small canary?
lisa: +1 for canary. add telemetry: rate of header/cookie mismatch, percent of affected dashboards, and SLO errors
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: `prefetch-v2` flag rollout starting in prod at 2024-12-17T21:00Z by canary 3% -> 10% -> 100%
jackie: quick test — turned flag on for my user, can't repro now
alex: make ticket: ENGPLAT-2987, include trace + sample time window + suggestion to deprecate cookie auth for internal console calls
ben: FYI we should also add server-side guard to ensure workspace param in URL matches header; return 400 if mismatch and log correlation id
sam: agree. risk: some older tooling may rely on cookie. add rollout doc and migration plan, and a compatibility header `X-Redwood-Prefer-Cookie: true` for legacy clients
jackie: thanks team, marking as blocked -> in-progress
(lots of :thumbsup: reactions)
